title: Control: email IOC rows and lists, prose / spoofed / vendor / redacted addresses, package specifiers, template URL in an email table, decrypted malware configuration

provenance.method: constructed from the post-finalization remediation shapes: 35946 / 35948 / 35955 IOC tables with 'Email address' rows, 35943 'Emails associated with this activity' IOC-section list, 35956 prose 'attacker-controlled ProtonMail address', 33348 spoofed brand sender, 35441 vendor contact address, 35661 redacted extortion contact, 35956 npm package specifiers, 35590 template URL row in a table that also holds email rows, and the 35951 Winos4.0 decrypted configuration (with an example-format negative)
provenance.verified_by: construction + manual comparison with each publisher article
provenance.notes: An address the publisher lists (IOC table row / IOC-section bullet) is an Indicator. An address in prose — even an attacker-controlled one — is context the analyst may promote; a spoofed sender and a vendor contact are context; a redacted address and a package specifier are not observables. The decrypted-configuration C2 is report context for membership (promotion evidence only), and the example-format slot is never evidence.
